Title: Aqua Universalis
Description: Aqua Universalis is a fresh, clean scent inspired by pure simplicity, blending bergamot, Sicilian lemon, lily of the valley, sweet orange, and soft blond musky wood.

Title: Aqua Kiss
Description: Victoria’s Secret Aqua Kiss body mist is a fresh, airy fragrance that captures the feeling of rain-kissed daisies and a clean summer breeze, leaving you confident and irresistible.

Title: Cotton Blossom
Description: Bath and Body Works Cotton Blossom Fragrance Mist blends sun-dried linen, fresh grass, and crisp mandarin for a light, elegant scent. With notes of peony and clean cotton, it finishes with soft musk and baby powder.

Title: Blanche
Description: Byredo Blanche is a timeless fragrance that captures the essence of texture and skin. It evokes the feeling of fresh sheets, overflowing laundry baskets, and a hint of detergent. The scent begins with an aldehyde burst, transitioning into delicate rose, while sandalwood and musk add a touch of warmth, reflecting the intimacy and allure of human touch.

Title: Clean Reserve Skin
Description: Skin by Clean is a Floral Woody Musk fragrance for both women and men. It opens with fresh top notes of honeysuckle, bergamot, and orange blossom, leading to a heart of skin, vanilla orchid, and peony. The fragrance settles into a base of salt, musk, praline, and white cedar extract, creating a warm, comforting, and alluring scent.

Title: BYR3D0 BLANCHE Inspired Perfume
Description: This inspired perfume captures the essence of freshness with the crisp scent of white cotton and strong linen, complemented by delicate white floral notes, creating a clean, airy, and elegant fragrance.

Title: Aqua Allegoria Herba Fresca
Description: Herba Fresca is a fresh and natural Eau de Toilette, evoking the feeling of walking barefoot in dewy, freshly cut grass. Housed in a pure, refined bottle adorned with a golden mesh, it honors the iconic Guerlain Bee Bottle.

Title: Bergamot & White Musk
Description: Bergamot & Musk is a fresh fragrance that opens with vibrant bursts of bergamot and apple, transitioning to a sharp heart of birch, patchouli, jasmine, and rose. The musky base of oakmoss and amber is delicately supported by a light vanilla foundation.

Title: Santal
Description: Santal by MindScent MNL is a fresh and elegant Eau de Toilette, blending clean notes with light florals and soft musk. Perfect for everyday wear, it offers a balanced and lasting freshness that leaves a confident, invigorating impression.

Title: Eau de Magnolia
Description: Eau De Magnolia captures the vibrant, uplifting essence of fresh magnolia blossoms, offering a captivating and timeless fragrance for those seeking a truly enchanting scent.

Title: Gingham
Description: A fresh, vibrant burst of joy, this scent captures everything you love about Bath & Body Works. With notes of blue freesia, white peach, fresh clementine, violet, and clean musk, it’s a lively celebration in every spritz.

Title: If You Musk
Description: This fragrance was made just for you, designed to let your natural radiance shine and highlight your best qualities. With notes of iris, pink pepper, and airy musk, it creates an everlasting scent that brings out your inner brilliance.

Title: Tam-Dao
Description: A memory from the sacred forests of Indochina: the soft, milky scent of sandalwood burning in temples. Yves Coueslant, co-founder of Diptyque, captured this childhood fragrance—Mysore sandalwood cooled by lively cypress and myrtle.

Title: Woodsage & Sea Salt
Description: Escape the everyday to windswept shores, where waves break white and the air brims with sea salt and spray. The mineral scent of rugged cliffs blends with the woody earthiness of sage—lively, spirited, and full of joy.
ImagePath: ../Wood Sage & Sea Salt – Jo Malone London.png

Title: Sage Cedarwood Essence
Description: A fresh, earthy escape into the woods, this fragrance scents your skin, elevates every shower, and refreshes your pillows and linens with a touch of everyday luxury.

Title: Oud Wood
Description: One of the rarest and most prized ingredients in perfumery, TOM FORD Oud Wood evokes the incense-filled temples of Bhutan. Exotic rosewood and cardamom open into a smoky blend of rare oud, sandalwood, and vetiver, while tonka bean and amber wrap the scent in warmth and sensuality.

Title: Black Pepper & Cedarwood
Description: Black Pepper & Cedarwood by Zara is a bold woody-spicy fragrance for men, featuring a burst of black pepper, a heart of delicate rose, and a grounding base of rich cedar.

Title: Poison Woody
Description: A Unisex Luxury Woody Eau de Parfum – a captivating scent for both men and women. Rich, warm woods create a sophisticated fragrance that leaves a lasting impression.

Title: Terre d’Hermes
Description: Terre d’Hermès blends the vibrant strength of citrus and pepper with a flinty mineral note, evoking the bond between man and earth. It tells a story of harmony with nature and reconnects man to his origins—the true source of his creative power.

Title: Woody Sandalwood
Description: Woody Sandalwood pays tribute to the precious, often overlooked beauty of sandalwood. Centered around the rare Mysore variety from India, this scent reveals sandalwood’s creamy richness, balancing the sharpness of other woods and adding smooth depth to floral notes. Blended with sweet violet, classic orris, and warm musk, Woody Sandalwood is a modern classic in the making.

Title: Forest Dew
Description: Say yes to adventure with a radiant blend of citrus, white florals, and the comforting essence of warm woods.

Title: Bois d’Hiver
Description: Bois D’Hiver opens with invigorating top notes of cardamom and pink pepper, delivering a spicy, fresh introduction that awakens the senses. As it evolves, the heart reveals a harmonious blend of white cedar, heliotrope, and cyclamen, adding a soft floral layer that perfectly balances the spice.

Title: In The Stars
Description: Like witnessing a once-in-a-lifetime comet streak across the night sky, this scent is truly unforgettable. It blends starflower, sandalwood musk, sugared tangelo, white agarwood, and radiant amber into a dazzling, otherworldly fragrance.

Title: Twilight Woods
Description: Twilight Woods captures the magic of a romantic walk through enchanted woods at twilight. A feminine blend of bright flowers, surprising spices, and creamy woods, wrapped in a cozy touch of cashmere. Perfect for cozy nights in or magical nights out, this fragrance offers a soothing warmth, evoking luxury and comfort. Part of Bath & Body Works' "Cuddler" collection, designed to make you feel relaxed and comforted.

Title: Orange Blossom
Description: A shimmering garden oasis, where clementine flower sparkles over orange blossom and water lily, with warm notes of orris and balsamic vetiver. Pure delight.

Title: Bergamote 22
Description: Bergamote 22 by Le Labo is a unisex fragrance known for its citrusy-fresh scent.

Title: De Levante 198
Description: This fragrance opens with a refreshing burst of Sicilian lemon, crisp apple, and the smooth, woody notes of cedar and bellflower, creating an invigorating first impression. As it settles, the heart unfolds with the delicate essence of bamboo, jasmine, and white rose, adding a floral touch of elegance and freshness. The scent then deepens with a warm, earthy base of cedar, musk, and amber, leaving a lasting impression that's both comforting and sophisticated. A harmonious blend of freshness and warmth, perfect for any occasion.

Title: Citrus Bigarrade
Description: Citrus Bigarrade from The House of Creed’s Acqua Originale collection is a refreshing, effervescent fragrance inspired by Mediterranean sunshine. This vibrant Eau de Parfum blends zesty lemons, juicy mandarins, and white pepper, with cool peppermint, vetiver, and ginger creating a mouthwatering, lively scent. Perfect for any season, it transports you to a Southern European harbor where the sea breeze meets the sun, all housed in a luxurious Art Deco bottle.

Title: For Him Red Edition Intense
Description: Vibrant bursts of bergamot and grapefruit meet a rich blend of woody and spicy notes, crafting a bold and powerful scent. A captivating trio of amber, tonka, and black vanilla adds a modern twist of addictive warmth, revealing a deeper, magnetic allure. It's a story of heightened intensity, daring sensuality, and irresistible charm for those redefining the essence of masculinity.
ImagePath: For Him Red Edition Intense - Zara.png

Title: 01 GREY
Description: Grey is a fresh, unisex fragrance that captures the crisp, nostalgic vibe of the 90s. It opens with green notes, mandarin orange, bergamot, cardamom, and lemon, leading to a heart of violet, jasmine, rose, and nutmeg. The base combines sandalwood, amber, musk, cedar, and oakmoss for a warm, unique finish.

Title: Eau de Cologne
Description: An iconic symbol of elegance and simplicity, this light, solar fragrance captures the essence of a wildflower bouquet.

Title: Silver Summer
Description: The summer edition of Man Silver brings a fresh, vibrant blend of citrus and mint, brightened by aromatic hints of lavender and cardamom. It settles into a warm, sophisticated base of sandalwood, amber, and patchouli, perfectly capturing the spirit of the season.

Title: Apricot & Nashi Pear
Description: Apricot & Nashi Pear offers a captivating blend of floral, fruity, and citrusy notes, enhanced by a subtle musky undertone. The sweet, juicy apricot and crisp pear combine for a refreshing, light fragrance that’s both vibrant and inviting.

Title: Colonia
Description: Acqua Di Parma Colonia is a timeless citrus fragrance, blending lavender, rosemary, Sicilian citrus, Bulgarian rose, jasmine, amber, and light musk for a fresh, sophisticated scent.
ImagePath: ../Acqua di Parma Colonia - Acqua di Parma.png

Title: Hibiscus
Description: This Eau de Parfum highlights the hibiscus flower, with its fruity, musky allure. A tropical citrus blend of bitter orange and mandarin opens the scent, evoking a summer paradise. At its heart, peony mingles with the vibrant notes of mango and passion fruit, while vanilla orchid and amber create a creamy, comforting finish.

Title: Summer Citrus
Description: Introducing the QUICKFX Body Spray in Summer Citrus — your go-to for a zesty, refreshing scent that lasts up to 6 hours. Spray it on anytime for an instant burst of freshness, with the added bonus of anti-bacterial properties to keep you feeling clean all day.

Title: Eau de Cologne
Description: An iconic symbol of elegance and simplicity, this light, solar fragrance captures the essence of a wildflower bouquet.

Title: White Musk
Description: White Musk® Eau de Parfum is a soft yet powerful scent with floral, clean, and musky notes. Featuring aldehydes, jasmine, and cruelty-free musk, it evokes a sense of calm, confidence, and empowerment, leaving a lasting impression.

Title: L’ Artisan Parfumeur Drôle De Rose 2ML
Description: Drôle de Rose by L’Artisan Parfumeur is a floral fragrance with a modern, unisex appeal. It opens with fresh notes of rose and violet, giving a crisp and vibrant introduction. The heart blends orange blossom, iris, and soft powdery tones, offering a smooth and balanced character. The base is rounded out by subtle leather, warm honey, and clean musk, creating a scent that feels both intimate and effortlessly refined.
ImagePath: ../L_Artisan Parfumeur Voleur de Roses - Perfume Museum.png

Title: Love, Don’t Be Shy
Description: KILIAN PARIS Love, Don't Be Shy Eau de Parfum opens with a delicate orange blossom absolute, evoking the innocence of first love. Juicy honeysuckle and soft rose blend with sweet marshmallow sugar, capturing the essence of new romance. A warm amber base adds a sensual touch, hinting at deeper connection.

Title: Cashmere Glow
Description: It smells like curling up in warm, cozy cashmere to watch the sun rise, with notes of golden peach and delicate lily petals blending into the soft, comforting embrace of shimmering vanilla and cashmere musk.

Title: Fire
Description: Romantic, bold, and undeniably sexy — this fiery blend of Pink Grapefruit, Iris, and Bulgarian Rose captures attention like no other. Powerful yet beautifully balanced with soft floral and powdery notes, it's a scent that keeps the world enchanted by you.

Title: Infusion d’Iris
Description: Infusion d'Iris by Prada is a contemporary Eau de Parfum that reflects the brand's dedication to classic perfumery traditions. Crafted with high-quality natural ingredients, it offers a clean, fresh, and light scent, while remaining sophisticated and elegant. This intimate and personal fragrance gently envelops the wearer.

Title: Soft Musk
Description: Soft Musk transports you to a vibrant jungle, bathed in sunlight. The fragrance blends fresh floral and woody notes, with radiant citrus and warm woods at its heart. A solar ylang ylang adds richness, while a deep base of olibanum, cedarwood, and moss evokes the essence of dark woods.

Title: Baby Powder
Description: A soft, powdery scent that wraps you in a light, clean freshness, keeping you feeling effortlessly refreshed and confident all day long.

Title: Fleur de Peau
Description: Fleur de Peau pays tribute to the legendary love of Psyche and Eros, symbolizing the birth of their daughter, Hedone. The fragrance centers around musks, which are soft, cottony, and moist, enhanced by iris and ambrette seed to reveal their full, tactile essence.

Title: Warm Cotton
Description: Inspired by the comforting scent of freshly laundered tees from the dryer, this fragrance captures the essence of pure freshness and comfort.

Title: Powder Perfume
Description: Baby Powder Perfume is a soft, comforting scent that opens with fresh powder and delicate florals. A cozy heart of musk and cotton blends into creamy sandalwood and warm vanilla, leaving a clean, lasting impression.

Title: Eau de Lierre
Description: Ivy, a symbol of fidelity and attachment, has a scent that cannot be extracted, so it must be invented. diptyque Eau de Lierre captures its essence with fresh, slightly aquatic notes and a herbaceous blend reminiscent of green sap rising up a vine.

Title: Nasturtium & Clover
Description: Nasturtium & Clover by Jo Malone London is an aromatic green fragrance for both women and men. It opens with top notes of clover, bergamot, and lemon, followed by a heart of nasturtium, wild orchid, and jasmine. The base features vetiver, amberwood, and white musk.

Title: Byredo Bal d’Afrique
Description: Bal d'Afrique by Byredo is a vibrant unisex fragrance. It opens with fresh bergamot, lemon, and marigold, moves into soft jasmine and violet, and settles into warm vetiver, cedarwood, and musk. A bright, earthy scent inspired by African culture and 1920s Paris.

Title: Vetiver Extraordinaire
Description: The essence of an exceptionally charming man, magnetic without effort—every gesture infused with humor and sophistication. It's not a rugged, loud masculinity, but an irresistible, subtle whisper.

Title: Hermès Eau de Basilic
Description: Eau de Basilic Pourpre by Hermès is a unisex fragrance that captures the aromatic freshness of purple basil, invigorated by green bergamot and geranium. This light and airy scent offers a crisp, herbal character, perfect for those seeking a refreshing and versatile cologne.

Title: TSC Philosykos Inspired Perfume
Description: TSC Philosykos Inspired Perfume is a unisex fragrance that captures the essence of a Mediterranean fig grove. It opens with fresh green fig leaves, transitions into creamy fig fruit and milky sap, and settles into a warm base of fig wood and soft cedar. This scent evokes the sunlit serenity of a Greek summer, offering a clean, natural aroma suitable for all.
Brand: The Scents Co. by Love, Chloe
ImagePath: ../TSC Philosykos Inspired Perfume - The Scents Co. by Love, Chloe.png

Title: Un Jardin sur le Nil
Description: Un Jardin sur le Nil offers an impressionistic stroll through the island-gardens of the Nile at Aswan, beginning a new olfactory journey. At its heart, green mango, lotus, calamus, and sycamore wood create a refreshing, evocative scent.

Title: Basil & Neroli
Description: London at its most youthful and playful, where floral neroli flirts with a hint of basil. Quintessentially British, always fun, fresh, and full of adventure.

Title: Matcha Meditation Inspired
Description: Matcha Meditation Inspired Perfume is a unisex scent that evokes the calm of a matcha tea ceremony. It opens with green tea, bergamot, and mandarin, flows into jasmine and orange blossom, and settles into a soft base of white chocolate, moss, and cedar—offering a soothing, mindful experience.

Title: Eau de Campagne
Description: Eau de Campagne is a breath of fresh air, with the invigorating scents of forests and meadows that lift the spirit. Its composition blends bergamot, lemon, galbanum, tomato leaves, jasmine, lily of the valley, pelargonium, musk, patchouli, vetiver, oakmoss, plum, and basil.

Title: Green Tea
Description: Step into a lush, green world with Elizabeth Arden Green Tea — a fragrance that energizes the body, awakens the senses, and uplifts the spirit. Bursting with sparkling notes, it blends natural ingredients into a refreshing, revitalizing scent that brings balance and vitality to every moment.

Title: CK 1 (F1)
Description: F1 is the ideal fragrance to refresh and re-energize throughout the day. With a clean, pure, and contemporary scent, it offers a fresh perspective. Light and relaxed, this intimate fragrance is meant to be generously sprayed all over the body, best enjoyed up close.
